fusions.name: Rolled Cartridge
fusions.desc: Fires a ball from a paper cartridge into the first enemy it meets that deals 32 damage and always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Burning Wadding
fusions.desc: Fires 3 scraps of burning wadding at once, spread apart; each deals 3 damage.

fusions.name: Firing Table
fusions.desc: Consults a printed firing table: for 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

fusions.name: Filed Report
fusions.desc: Each critical hit sends a bolt to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles that deals 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
